name: Surprise — Constant Surprise
summary: Make each motion different from the last so the body keeps guessing what's next. Vary the shape, location, and speed of whatever already-working move you're using.
detailed_description: Constant surprise keeps every repetition fresh. Whatever move is working, change it each time: shape (circles to flicks to side-to-side), location (from above versus from the side), or speed and rhythm between repetitions. As one OMGYES participant (Sonya) put it, when the clit gets a new kind of attention than what happened just before, there's an extra burst of pleasure.
stepwise_structure: 1. Begin with a move the receiver enjoys.
2. On each repetition, change something: shape (circles, flicks, side-to-side).
3. Or change location—approach from above versus from the side.
5. Keep variations pleasurable and related, so each feels like new attention rather than a distraction.
safety_notes: Keep changes within pleasurable territory; avoid abrupt jarring touches.
Switch to one consistent motion once an orgasm is building.
